scope: Finite browser-local complete-file byte identity controls against an explicitly scoped frozen-report packet; not a signature, permission authentication, expert judgment or scientific accuracy

baseline.description: The new local-file check input is absent; not a corrupted original or broken preexisting preview.

checks: Actual licensed Du2014 PDF and synthetic DOCX, explicit frozen report/version identity
Same name/different file mismatch, renamed identical bytes match, single changed byte mismatch
Downloaded receipt SHA independently compared by Node crypto, full IDs and byte count
Only existing evaluation GET without request body during local checks; stored versions unchanged
390px viewport and reload reset; report switch/unmount suppresses held metadata result
Later selected file wins against earlier genuinely held metadata response
Empty and 25MiB+1 files rejected before metadata GET; 409, invalid source hash and digest error discard success
historicalProofPolicy: Keep prior fingerprints and labels unchanged; verify changed components against genuine earlier byte-verified source.
limitations: Complete-file identity only, not parsed-text, table or figure comprehension
Metadata must be available through the existing authorized report endpoint
JSON is locally generated and unsigned, not independent certification
Three finite Chromium flows do not certify every browser or device
